description: Use when testing a GraphQL API on an authorized engagement. Covers finding the endpoint, abusing introspection for full schema dumps, enumerating queries and mutations, authorization testing on every field, batching attacks for brute force, nested query denial of service, IDOR through global IDs, and subscription abuse. Use when an app exposes /graphql or /api/graphql, when introspection is enabled in production, or when a single endpoint serves all data operations and needs field-level access control review.
